proof_attempt_summary: The closed D0 graph derives full observed-model efficiency and feasible fixed-law attainment for a fixed positive latent-weight contrast, together with unrestricted single-channel nonregularity. Lawful source corrections, a moment-free diagonal Hellinger impossibility argument, and singular-mass likelihood repairs passed the mathematical referee. D0.5 stopped at subfield (6.8 versus the field score floor 7.4), with an unresolved comparator-priority caveat; F stages were never entered and no Lean output exists.
tldr: A regularity-frontier theorem pairs anchor-class one-channel nonregularity with retained-label two-channel regularity for the same fixed positive latent-weight eligibility effect. The one-channel impossibility excludes every regular estimator with any fixed Borel limiting error law, without a moment premise on that law. NIR observes scalar records without a precision label: forgetting \(V\) gives only a coarsening inclusion and transfers no positive efficiency or attainment result, while the variance-one model is a subclass of the published Gaussian NIR specialization and transfers the negative conclusion at the stated subclass laws. Two independent public Gaussian precision groups identify the contrast by bounded signed moments for arbitrary compactly supported latent densities and arbitrary Borel response means. At laws with positive integrated Bernoulli variance under each eligibility status, the paper proves the full original-record tangent complement, its coercive observable canonical equation, and data-only efficient attainment with feasible Wald inference from observed-control prediction consistency alone. The clinical consumer is a prospective calibrated two-assay version of the HIV eligibility-and-retention question of Bor et al.; the original records do not establish these protocol conditions.
gap: NIR supplies latent weighting, Trabs supplies abstract inverse-information geometry, and Agarwal--Singh supplies serious causal noisy-covariate inference and error-in-variable balancing. The accessible primary statements do not establish this fixed positive target's same-target regularity frontier and exhaustive original-record efficiency solution in the retained-label two-public-Gaussian-channel threshold experiment. This is a setting-specific opportunity, not a claim that noisy-covariate efficiency or exact covariate balancing is new. Priority relative to the inaccessible Delaigle--Meister--Zhang theorem remains unresolved.
fill: The regularity-frontier theorem pairs one-channel impossibility with two-channel root-\(n\) inference for the same fixed target. The paper must exhaust the full observed DQM tangent complement, derive its stable observable canonical equation, and construct an attaining learner using only observed control-prediction consistency. Agarwal--Singh's primary supplement is a methodological comparator; no cross-model dominance or subsumption claim is made, and unresolved Delaigle--Meister--Zhang priority limits the novelty claim.
